summary: Delivery v3 (express/standard-scheduled/shipping, shifts+pools, night planner, queue pickup, live banner, tips, ZENREX map) tested. Backend 10/11 pytest pass (public URL). Core flows work end-to-end: distance-priced express, shipping when > max_distance_km, slot capacity full/remaining, scheduled order stored, shift PUT + fleet pools/shift, express offers only to express-pool drivers, scheduled orders never offered, max_active_per_driver respected and waiting hot order dispatched after completion, plan run/get/move, driver queue -> pickup -> stop #1 en_route + notification -> auto next stop after complete, active-order banner API, tip rules (owner/delivered/balance/once/amount). UI verified on 390x844: driver queue card + long-press pickup, customer banner (after fix) -> track page, tip chips + send, driver Settings lang/theme switching, merchant shift modal, Scheduling tab run+move, delivery-settings new fields, checkout 2 options + day chips + full slot disabled. HIGH: when no settings.delivery doc exists (current DB state) scheduled quote returns ZERO slots -> customer cannot place a standard order. FIXED by me: live banner never rendered for customers (role is 'user'). No deprecated Expo packages detected. No SafeAreaView issues detected.

critical.issue: server.py:3110/3162/3184 use `db.settings.find_one({'key':'delivery'}) or {}` and `s.get('scheduled_slots', [])`; GET /api/delivery/settings returns hardcoded default slots but calculate-fee does not. DB currently has NO delivery settings doc -> scheduled_days[].slots = [] -> checkout slot modal shows 'No available time slots' and placeOrder blocks. Fix: single DEFAULT_DELIVERY_SETTINGS merged into all readers (calculate-fee, scheduled_days_with_capacity, planner, eligible_drivers) or seed the doc idempotently.

No server-side validation of scheduled_date/scheduled_slot: slot capacity not enforced (overbooking possible; remaining went to -1 in test), date not checked against allowed scheduled_days, delivery_type=scheduled with empty date is accepted and will never be planned.

minor.issue: delivery.py:834-842 check-then-set is not atomic; two parallel requests can both deduct wallet and double-tip. Claim tip first with update_one({_id, tip:{$exists:false}}) then deduct (rollback on low balance).

For planned stops not yet en_route (queue_waiting=true) response still includes driver.loc and route (verified), and ws 'sub' sends driver_loc (delivery.py:379-382, 871-882) - contradicts 'only the en_route customer sees the driver'.
Only excludes delivery_type=='scheduled'; orders with delivery_type 'shipping' (out of range) are offered to express drivers on ready_for_pickup (delivery.py:257).
Takes every planned order regardless of readiness (status 'processing') and overwrites driver_id even if merchant assigned it to someone else via /merchant/orders/{oid}/assign (delivery.py:818-822).
remaining can go negative when overbooked; clamp to 0.
No Pydantic validation; arbitrary keys/types are $set.
settings doc re-fetched inside per-driver loop (delivery.py:243).

ui_bugs.issue: Banner only rendered for role 'customer' but customers have role 'user' -> never shown. FIXED by testing agent (added user.role === 'user').
Empty slot list when settings doc missing (see backend critical) -> standard delivery unusable.
